Anya: quick Figma link + question — when we regroup the left sidebar, how should deep-links behave for nested items? e.g. user hits /workspaces/sky/models/model-abc — do we auto-expand the Models group and move keyboard focus to the item? https://www.figma.com/file/xyz :link: Sam: yes — deep-links should expand and reveal the item. otherwise screen-reader users land on a collapsed group and have no context. aria-expanded should be true and focus should go to the item. :eyes: Marco: fine but watch scroll jumps. if we force expand and focus we might cause left-nav to jump, losing surrounding context. can we open silently and then focus without changing scroll pos? Liz: my proposal: expand the group, add an in-nav anchor id like `nav-model-abc`, set `aria-current="true"` on the item, then call `element.focus()` with focus ring. also tooltip for truncated name. Toni: ARIA skeleton: ```html
  • Models
    • Model ABC
``` Sam: routing side note — router could expose state via query like `?open=models&selected=model-abc` but canonical routes should be `/workspaces/:w/models/:modelId` and the router hook should translate that into nav open+select on mount. keeps URLs nice for sharing. Anya: copy nit: breadcrumbs should read `Workspace • Models • Model ABC` (dot separators), not slashes. long names get truncated with `…` and tooltip on hover. Marco: keyboard flow to validate: Tab -> focus left nav -> ArrowDown lands on group header -> Enter or RightArrow expands -> ArrowDown into items -> item receives focus. verify with NVDA/VoiceOver. Maybe role=tree is overkill; try rolenav + rolegroup semantics first. NavBot: automated checklist item created: `leftnav deep-link expands and focuses` added to a11y test plan (#A11Y-192). Liz: small UX question — if user previously manually collapsed Models, should a deep-link respect that preference or override it? I lean override — deep-link signals intent. Toni: agree override, but animate expansion for context (slide + subtle fade). keeps orientation. Sam: action items: (1) router hook to expand on mount + canonicalize routes (Sam), (2) implement `aria-current` + focus id (Toni), (3) preserve left-nav scroll when expanding (Marco), (4) breadcrumb copy + tooltip for truncation (Anya), (5) add automated a11y check (Liz). Anya: I'll update the Figma frames and open a PR with screenshots and keyboard gif. tagging @Sam @Marco @Liz @Toni — thanks! :thumbsup:
